problem: Commercial messages could choose persuasion and channel without first maintaining a shared, explicit customer-need state.
root_cause: Interest signals, trigger evidence and buyer-confirmed need were represented in separate layers, so a click or public signal could advance messaging without a consistent discovery stage.
change: Added one shared need-discovery engine and contract
Added database event/profile and prepared-action enrichment
Applied the next-question function immediately before autonomous email selection
Added Portal V2 Sales Intelligence projection
Added agent skill and universal contract
prevention: No commercial node may treat engagement as a confirmed need. Offer eligibility requires buyer-confirmed problem, impact and urgency.
